title: Marveling at the Miracles of God's Throne Room
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he takes us on a journey through the Bible's most incredible miracles and visions, revealing the awe-inspiring power and presence of God in the lives of His people. Tonight, we'll explore the prophet Isaiah's breathtaking vision of the throne room of God, a sight that left even the most righteous of men in awe of the Almighty. Don't miss this powerful sermon that will leave you marveling at the glory of God and your place in His plan.
